messages.content: Oliver picks 44 kiwis on Friday. Then he picks 58 kiwis on Saturday. On Sunday, he picks double the number of kiwis he did on Friday. How many kiwis does Oliver have? Give only the final number.

Oliver picks 44 kiwis on Friday. Then he picks 58 kiwis on Saturday. On Sunday, he picks double the number of kiwis he did on Friday. On Sunday, five of the kiwis he picked were a bit smaller than average. How many kiwis does Oliver have? Give only the final number.
A bakery sells 24 croissants in the morning and 36 in the afternoon. How many croissants did the bakery sell in total? Give only the final number.

A bakery sells 24 croissants in the morning and 36 in the afternoon. 10 of the afternoon croissants were slightly overbaked but still sold. How many croissants did the bakery sell in total? Give only the final number.
Maria buys 5 packs of pencils with 12 pencils in each pack. How many pencils does Maria have? Give only the final number.
Maria buys 5 packs of pencils with 12 pencils in each pack. 3 of the packs have blue boxes instead of red ones. How many pencils does Maria have? Give only the final number.
A parking lot has 8 rows with 15 spaces each. 37 spaces are currently occupied. How many spaces are free? Give only the final number.
A parking lot has 8 rows with 15 spaces each. 37 spaces are currently occupied. 6 of the occupied spaces have cars that are older than 10 years. How many spaces are free? Give only the final number.
Tom runs 3 miles every weekday and 5 miles on each weekend day. How many miles does he run in a week? Give only the final number.
Tom runs 3 miles every weekday and 5 miles on each weekend day. On Wednesday it rained, so he ran a bit slower than usual. How many miles does he run in a week? Give only the final number.
A library had 320 books. It received a donation of 85 books and then lent out 47. How many books does the library have now? Give only the final number.

A library had 320 books. It received a donation of 85 books and then lent out 47. 12 of the donated books were paperbacks with slightly bent covers. How many books does the library have now? Give only the final number.
Liam has $120. He spends $35 on a game and $18 on lunch. How much money does Liam have left? Give only the final number.
Liam has $120. He spends $35 on a game and $18 on lunch. The game was originally priced at $45 before a discount. How much money does Liam have left? Give only the final number.
A farmer collects 14 eggs each morning for 6 days. How many eggs did the farmer collect? Give only the final number.
A farmer collects 14 eggs each morning for 6 days. On two of those mornings, a few of the eggs were brown rather than white. How many eggs did the farmer collect? Give only the final number.
A classroom has 6 tables with 4 students at each table, plus 3 students sitting at the teacher's desk. How many students are in the classroom? Give only the final number.

A classroom has 6 tables with 4 students at each table, plus 3 students sitting at the teacher's desk. 5 of the students at the tables are left-handed. How many students are in the classroom? Give only the final number.
Sophie reads 22 pages a day for 9 days and then 15 pages on the tenth day. How many pages did Sophie read in total? Give only the final number.
Sophie reads 22 pages a day for 9 days and then 15 pages on the tenth day. On the fourth day, 7 of the pages were mostly pictures. How many pages did Sophie read in total? Give only the final number.
